en: Colored vintage postcard view of an alpine village in a narrow valley surrounded by steep, forested and rocky mountains. A river with a small waterfall runs in the foreground beside stone walls and wooden waterworks. Traditional Tyrolean-style houses with wooden roofs and balconies stand in the middle ground, one flying a red‑white‑red horizontal flag. A church with a square bell tower and pointed spire is prominent on the right. Snow‑covered peaks of the Dolomites rise in the background. The caption text is printed along the top edge.
